definitions.explanation: The seat of government, especially historically.
A major urban center, especially one known for culture or sophistication.

examples.japanese: ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{都|みやこ}⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{奈良|なら}→奈良：27451_nara⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{都|みやこ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Nara is known as an ancient capital.

examples.notes: Poetic expression for a beautiful city

notes:
A somewhat literary or classical word for capital city.

HISTORICAL CAPITALS OF JAPAN:
- ⟦{奈良|なら}→奈良：27451_nara⟧ (710-784)
- ⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧ (794-1868)
- ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧ (1868-present)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{都|みやこ} (beautiful city, city of flowers)
- ⟦{古|ふる}→古〜：03966_furu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{都|みやこ}/⟦{古都|こと}→古都：11804_koto⟧ (ancient capital)
- {都|みやこ}⟦{落|お}ち→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ (fleeing the capital)

RELATED READINGS:
- {都|みやこ} - capital (native reading)
- {都|と} - metropolis (as in ⟦{東京都|とうきょうと}→東京都：noentry⟧)
- ⟦{首都|しゅと}→首都：03224_shuto⟧ - capital city (modern term)
